unit_cn: Unit 1 Festivals and Celebrations 节日与庆典
source: 人教版2019必修三 Unit 1 词表(节日与庆典主题真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、含目标词、围绕节日庆典主题、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Families gather to celebrate the festival together every year.
words.example_cn: 每年家人都聚在一起庆祝这个节日。

words.example_en: The whole town joined in the New Year celebration.
words.example_cn: 全城都参加了新年庆典。

words.example_en: The opening ceremony of the festival was truly amazing.
words.example_cn: 节日的开幕仪式真是令人惊叹。

words.meaning_cn: 特别的事情(或仪式、庆典);机会;场合
words.example_en: A wedding is a happy occasion for the whole family.
words.example_cn: 婚礼对全家来说是一个喜庆的场合。

words.example_en: Few people know the true origin of this ancient festival.
words.example_cn: 很少有人知道这个古老节日的真正起源。

words.example_en: Lighting firecrackers is a typical Spring Festival custom.
words.example_cn: 放鞭炮是春节的一个典型习俗。

words.example_en: Frightening away evil spirits is part of the tradition.
words.example_cn: 驱赶恶灵是这一传统的一部分。

words.example_en: People wear traditional costumes during the festival.
words.example_cn: 人们在节日期间穿着传统服装。

words.example_en: Some festivals come from religion, others from the seasons.
words.example_cn: 有些节日源于宗教,有些则源于季节。

words.example_en: Halloween became a fun festival in spite of its religious origins.
words.example_cn: 尽管万圣节有宗教渊源,它还是变成了一个有趣的节日。

words.example_en: The harvest festival is held after the crops are gathered in.
words.example_cn: 丰收节在庄稼收割之后举行。

words.example_en: People celebrate when all the crops have been gathered in.
words.example_cn: 当所有庄稼都收割完毕时,人们便庆祝。

words.example_en: Families gather to admire the shining moon at the Mid-Autumn Festival.
words.example_cn: 中秋节时家人聚在一起赏明月。

words.example_en: People celebrate to show they are grateful for the food.
words.example_cn: 人们庆祝是为了表达对食物的感激。

words.example_en: The festival is a way of showing gratitude for the harvest.
words.example_cn: 这个节日是表达对丰收感激之情的一种方式。

words.example_en: The spirit of sharing joy is common in all festivals.
words.example_cn: 分享喜悦的精神是所有节日共有的。

words.example_en: The Lantern Festival is a joyful occasion for everyone.
words.example_cn: 元宵节对每个人来说都是一个欢乐的日子。

words.example_en: People sing carols and wish each other a merry Christmas.
words.example_cn: 人们唱颂歌,互祝圣诞快乐。

words.example_en: People decorate churches and town halls with flowers and fruit.
words.example_cn: 人们用鲜花和水果装饰教堂和市政厅。

words.example_en: Floating lanterns light up the whole river at night.
words.example_cn: 漂浮的灯笼在夜里照亮了整条河。

words.example_en: The beautiful fireworks lit up the night sky over the city.
words.example_cn: 绚丽的烟花照亮了城市的夜空。

words.example_en: Lighting firecrackers is said to drive away evil spirits.
words.example_cn: 据说放鞭炮能驱赶恶灵。

words.meaning_cn: (某地或某历史时期的)服装;戏装
words.example_en: Dancers in colourful costumes marched along the streets.
words.example_cn: 穿着五彩服装的舞者沿街游行。

words.example_en: Crowds march along the streets during the carnival.
words.example_cn: 狂欢节期间人群沿街行进。

words.example_en: A wedding is one of the most important family celebrations.
words.example_cn: 婚礼是最重要的家庭庆典之一。

words.example_en: On New Year's Eve, all the family members get together.
words.example_cn: 除夕之夜,全家人都聚在一起。

words.example_en: Children get lucky money in red envelopes from their relatives.
words.example_cn: 孩子们从亲戚那里得到装在红包里的压岁钱。

words.example_en: Roast turkey is the main dish at a Thanksgiving dinner.
words.example_cn: 烤火鸡是感恩节晚餐的主菜。

words.example_en: The ancient harvest festival featured a parade and a great feast.
words.example_cn: 古代的丰收节以游行和盛大的宴会为特色。

words.example_en: Festivals reflect people's wishes, beliefs and attitudes towards life.
words.example_cn: 节日反映了人们的愿望、信念和对生活的态度。

words.example_en: The colour red represents good luck in Chinese culture.
words.example_cn: 在中国文化中,红色象征好运。

words.example_en: Customs play a significant role in every festival.
words.example_cn: 习俗在每个节日中都起着重要作用。

words.meaning_cn: 典型的;有代表性的;平常的
words.example_en: Lighting firecrackers is a typical custom of the Spring Festival.
words.example_cn: 放鞭炮是春节的一个典型习俗。

words.example_en: Different regions celebrate the same festival in different ways.
words.example_cn: 不同地区以不同方式庆祝同一个节日。

words.meaning_cn: 商业(化)的;以获利为目的的
words.example_en: Some people worry that festivals are becoming too commercial.
words.example_cn: 有些人担心节日正变得过于商业化。

words.example_en: Many people debate whether festivals should be commercialised.
words.example_cn: 许多人争论节日是否应该被商业化。

words.meaning_cn: 逐渐消失;(使)褪色;(身体)变虚弱
words.example_en: With the spread of new ideas, some old customs may fade away.
words.example_cn: 随着新观念的传播,一些旧习俗可能会逐渐消失。

words.meaning_cn: 邪恶的;有害的;邪恶;罪恶
words.example_en: Firecrackers are lit to drive away the evil spirits.
words.example_cn: 燃放鞭炮是为了驱赶恶灵。

words.example_en: Festivals reflect people's beliefs and faiths.
words.example_cn: 节日反映了人们的信念和信仰。

words.example_en: On this day people show respect to the elderly.
words.example_cn: 在这一天人们向长辈表示尊敬。

words.example_en: During the Lantern Festival, people enjoy guessing riddles.
words.example_cn: 元宵节期间,人们喜欢猜灯谜。

words.example_en: That was the moment I understood why people love this festival.
words.example_cn: 正是那一刻,我明白了人们为何热爱这个节日。

words.example_en: Every festival has its own customs and unique charm.
words.example_cn: 每个节日都有自己的习俗和独特魅力。

words.example_en: The festival falls on a fixed day of the lunar calendar.
words.example_cn: 这个节日落在阴历的某个固定日子。

words.example_en: Strong men wrestle on the green field during the festival.
words.example_cn: 节日期间,壮汉们在绿色的场地上摔跤。

words.example_en: I was moved by the dancers' show of strength and grace.
words.example_cn: 舞者们展现的力量与优雅令我深受感动。

words.example_en: We set off early to reach the festival before sunrise.
words.example_cn: 我们一早就动身,以便在日出前赶到节日现场。
